prose: Apple introduced the fourth-gen Apple TV 4K at its Welcome Home event: A19 chip, 128GB, far-field microphones for hands-free Siri, Find My in the remote and surround sound with up to four HomePods. It is the first model with Siri AI and costs $299, more than twice the previous generation's launch price (The Verge).
highlights: Fourth-gen Apple TV 4K at $299 with an A19 chip and 128GB.
Far-field mics for hands-free Siri; remote has Find My.
First device with Siri AI; pairs up to four HomePods for surround.
